text: loading a list of 1806 shaders chokes lets be a bit more realistic in the sorting here so i can actually browse them
resolution: Reduced the material picker load from the previous all-quality shader preset blast to a browse tier that only registers standard-quality authored takes. All 1,684 generated preset ids still exist and compile can still resolve them by id, but TEXTURE_REGISTRY and assignable material browsing now include only 340 browse presets plus the base recipes, bringing the built-in registry to 462 entries instead of loading the full 1,806-item shader list. Tests now pin that nonstandard qualities stay out of the normal picker while remaining resolvable for compile/back-compat.
